mapper.select: select sum(f.qualified_qty * p.ref_price) from mms_finish_receipt f inner join ( select material_id, avg(unit_price) as ref_price from wms_inbound_order_detail where del_flag = '0' and unit_price is not null and unit_price > 0 group by material_id ) p on p.material_id = f.product_id where f.del_flag = '0' and f.status = '1' and f.qualified_qty is not null and f.qualified_qty > 0 and f.finish_time >= #{start} and f.finish_time < #{end}
select sum(net_salary) from biz_hr_payslip where del_flag = '0' and `year_month` = #{yearMonth}
select employee_status as status, count(*) as cnt from biz_hr_employee where del_flag = '0' group by employee_status
